notes: Stream list on TV is now much more compact, so several streams fit on screen instead of one. Added an addon picker above the list (AIOStreams, Torrentio and so on) that you move through with left and right on the remote. Removed the X button from the popup since Back closes it. Also fixed remote navigation inside popups so it follows the on-screen layout: left and right move along a row, up and down move between rows.
